findings.problem: The vendor sheet's line table renders the money value as the raw server decimal string: {cell.unit_price} (and raw {cell.quantity}). No digit grouping, no fixed fraction digits, and no negative treatment (parentheses/icon/colour) — the value is whatever _s() produced on the server. Its sibling view on the same page (Detail.tsx line 23, By Line) renders the same cell's unit cost through the shared component, so one page shows two money formats. Every other money display in the new screens (PO editor/changes, vendor copy, comparison matrix, bids, award) uses Money or formatMoney.
findings.fix: Render the cell through the shared component with the vendor's currency: <Money value={cell.unit_price} currency={v.currency} zero="value" /> (the column header already names v.currency), and group the quantity with formatQuantity as the LinePicker/BidSheet do.
